chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) said:
Three things increase memory and eliminate phlegm: Reciting the Qur'an, honey, and frankincense.
ai.seo_question: What are the three things that improve memory and eliminate phlegm according to Ali ibn Abi Talib?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) links spiritual practice with physical health, identifying Qur'anic recitation, honey, and frankincense as remedies for enhancing memory and clearing phlegm. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the integration of *tadabbur* (reflection) and *tilawah* (recitation) with prophetic medicine (*al-tibb al-nabawi*), illustrating how divine words serve as both spiritual nourishment and physical healing.
